names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him is «Лаврентий (Когтев), мч.»; the rank is stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «… Лаврентия». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Анатолия, Александра, Евгения, Константина, Николая пресвитеров, и с ними мчч. Петра, Евсевия, Михаила, Дорофея, Лаврентия, Григория и мцц. Александры и Татианы (1937).»

attestations.note: Tenth of the thirteen one line enumerates, and the fifth of the six laymen. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS for him. `related` is left empty for the whole company, as the corpus leaves it for the thirty-four of Valaam; the line is quoted whole here instead. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century entries. No folder held him: a Cyrillic grep for «Когтев» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under any of the thirteen names.
